findings.finding: The saved schematic carries all four USB/CAN selector resistors. Exclusivity is an assembly requirement, independently checked using BOM/profile masks; raw netlist alone does not electrically isolate an incorrectly assembled board.

Initial review found normalized BOM Value dropped tolerance/voltage/dielectric. Root fixed export with Specification, Procurement_Status and Requirements, then removed duplicate L1/J2 suffixes. Actual native property readback checks all52 power parts in both versions for source_description, ASSEMBLY, group, limits and procurement status. ECO I2C current Value=3.3k, source_description=3.3k1%, ECO_REASON and BOM Specification=3.3k1% state revised assembly; original power spec and baseline preserve2.2k history.
Most capacitor/connector MPNs remain unspecified. Effective Buck input/output and LDO capacitance, PCB thermal behavior, loop stability and inrush/fuse coordination have not been measured.

findings.topic: LDO reverse feed and input protection
findings.finding: TLV755 is not reverse-blocking. Normal power nets are correct but reverse external header/SWD powering is forbidden, rapid input collapse remains a hardware test; F_IN+SS14 handles specified overcurrent/reversal and does not certify surge/OVP.

2N7002 gate10k/1M is read back correctly; resistance-guarantee calculation assumes VBUS at connector >=4.75V. Firmware PB0 sense and PA8 attach timing, lower-VBUS operation and powered-off DP/DM behavior are untested.

Pin5 and pin8 correctly NC; no standby control exists. Internal+external TXD pull-up establishes recessive while disconnected. Short bench use and device-level ESD ratings do not imply automotive bus-fault or board-level surge/ESD compliance.

findings.topic: I2C rate and inconsistent manufacturer footnote
findings.finding: Default teaching speed is100kHz. DS5319 Rev20 Table41 footnote2 PDF68 says PCLK1 must be a multiple of10MHz for400kHz, while Table42 PDF69 presents36MHz and400kHz/CCR0x801E. Both pages were independently text-read and visually inspected. The calculated282.405ns ECO RC rise at100pF proves only a300ns RC budget, not all MCU Fast-mode timing or hardware operation. <=400kHz on the CAD interface is an upper design envelope, not a passed400kHz runtime claim.
